flows:
Navigate to https://www.usa.gov/ then Work exclusively inside the Reading view dialog.
Use only its listed roles, names and controls.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
If a CAPTCHA or access challenge appears, @v16:"stop and report it".
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
In Reading view, first assert a Search textbox row is present.
Type taxes into Search and submit.
Verify search results for taxes appear.
Stay on the public site.

summary:

verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent used the visible Search textbox and visible Search button in Reading view, entered the required query, and submitted it. Its actions did not cause the failure. Although the initial row-presence assertion was recorded as failed, the attached Reading view shows a visible searchbox named Search, and the run proceeded to interact with that intended control. The terminal outcome is best explained by the failed network navigation, not an incorrect agent action.
